item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of 3 Doors Down, dies at 47 after cancer battle
item.description: Brad Arnold, founder and lead singer of 3 Doors Down, has died after a battle with cancer. He was 47.

item.title: Armchair detectives flood social media as search for Savannah Guthrie's missing mom continues
item.description: Moments after the news broke about the apparent abduction of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's mother, the floodgates opened on social media.

item.title: Elon Musk's underground tunnels in Las Vegas face scrutiny over safety, environmental concerns
item.description: Elon Musk's "Vegas Loop," an underground transit system of private tunnels, is facing scrutiny from Nevada lawmakers after years of complaints about workplace safety and alleged violations.

item.title: Gabriel Fernandez's mother again seeking resentencing in 8-year-old son's torture death
item.description: The mother of Gabriel Fernandez has filed court papers again seeking resentencing in connection with her guilty plea to the first-degree murder of her 8-year-old son.

item.title: Councilmember Nithya Raman announces run for LA mayor, joins crowded field hours before deadline
item.description: Los Angeles Councilmember Nithya Raman on Saturday announced her candidacy for mayor of Los Angeles, hours before a filing deadline at noon.

item.title: Dozens of bicyclists seen riding with the traffic on 101 Freeway, video shows
item.description: New video shows a bizarre scene on the 101 Freeway in Echo Park, where dozens of people were seen riding bicycles on the freeway on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: SoCal to see sunny Super Bowl Sunday before rain chances return next week
item.description: Southern California will see warm and sunny conditions for Super Bowl Sunday before a big shift in weather brings a chance of rain next week.

item.title: 2 surfers missing off coast of Santa Cruz, California, US Coast Guard says
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for two missing surfers in California. The Coast Guard received a report from bystanders of the surfers in the water yelling for help approximately 200 yards offshore.

item.title: Shocking video shows LAFD firefighter fall from ladder while battling Arlington Heights house fire
item.description: Video posted to the Citizen app shows onlookers gasp as the firefighter falls off the ladder from the height of the home's roof.

item.title: Gov. Newsom declares Super Bowl Sunday 'Bad Bunny Day' in California in post trolling Pres. Trump
item.description: It's a big weekend for Bad Bunny fans! Gov. Gavin Newsom declared Super Bowl Sunday "Bad Bunny Day" in California ahead of his halftime performance in the Bay Area.
